question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a pink ball, Bob has a purple ball, and Claire has a brown ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Bob swap balls. Finally, Bob and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Claire has the
Options:
(A) pink ball
(B) purple ball
(C) brown ball
solution:
Ball colors in (Alice, Bob, Claire) order:
Initial: (pink, purple, brown)
1. Alice and Bob swap: (purple, pink, brown)
2. Claire and Bob swap: (purple, brown, pink)
3. Bob and Claire swap: (purple, pink, brown)
Claire has the brown ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
